name: scheduled-pr-review
query: I want Claude to review every pull request opened in my GitHub repo automatically and post a summary comment. The review should follow our team review checklist. It must run even when nobody is at their machine.
expected_behavior: Restate the scenario in one sentence.
Answer the DIAGNOSTICO.md question set, noting frequency=on-event, interaction=headless/routine, trust=shared team.
Recommend a routine as the primary primitive, citing docs/claude/agentes/07-rotinas-agendadas.md.
Recommend a skill that owns the review checklist, cited to docs/claude/skills/01-skills.md.
Recommend a notification step (GitHub PR comment) at the end of the routine.
State at least one rejected alternative (for example a local hook) with the reason it fails the offline requirement.
Specify a permission allowlist restricted to the review tools plus the GitHub comment tool.
Propose a rollout in ordered steps with a rollback path.
Propose an adoption metric with baseline and target.
forbidden_behavior: Invent a Claude Code field or primitive not present in docs/claude/.
Recommend an MCP server without justifying why native tools plus permission allowlist are insufficient.
Fail to separate primitive choice, orchestration, guardrails, and rollout.
success_criteria: The routine primitive is selected with the correct doc citation.
The skill is proposed to hold the checklist rather than embedding the checklist in the routine prompt.
The recommendation includes a rollback path (disable the routine, keep the skill).
Every technical claim is traceable to a docs/claude/ file.
